host_about:
Thess Residences is a newly established complex of luxury yet affordable flats right in the heart of the city centre and in one of the “hottest” areas of Thessaloniki (or Saloniki as mostly called in Greece). Offering novel self-catering apartments serving as short or long term rentals in Thessaloniki, Thess Residences is your personal residence in Thessaloniki whatever your visiting schedule, from a few days until a few months; whether you are looking for vacation apartments for rent in Thessaloniki or you are travelling for business, Thess Residences offers a variety of luxury flats to serve all needs.
Built in 1951, the building was initially run by a Greek family that survived the 1922 disaster in Smyrni and served as a large factory that manufactured traditional pots, pans and “briki”. Briki is a kitchenware utensil used mostly to make the famous Greek coffee following a certain ritual. And as we could not but honour this legacy of the building, you will find a “briki” in your apartment kitchen along with coffee-making instructions in order to enjoy not only the classic Greek coffee but also the making of it! This is the definition of your home away from home where you will get to relax and make your plans on what to do in Thessaloniki while having a bit of the city’s culture in your apartment. Whether you are visiting for work, studies or just holidays, Thess Residences is the only choice for fully serviced apartments in Thessaloniki that resemble more a proper house or block of flats than short or long term rentals.

description:

host_about:
Thess Residences is a newly established complex of luxury yet affordable flats right in the heart of the city centre and in one of the “hottest” areas of Thessaloniki (or Saloniki as mostly called in Greece). Offering novel self-catering apartments serving as short or long term rentals in Thessaloniki, Thess Residences is your personal residence in Thessaloniki whatever your visiting schedule, from a few days until a few months; whether you are looking for vacation apartments for rent in Thessaloniki or you are travelling for business, Thess Residences offers a variety of luxury flats to serve all needs.
Built in 1951, the building was initially run by a Greek family that survived the 1922 disaster in Smyrni and served as a large factory that manufactured traditional pots, pans and “briki”. Briki is a kitchenware utensil used mostly to make the famous Greek coffee following a certain ritual. And as we could not but honour this legacy of the building, you will find a “briki” in your apartment kitchen along with coffee-making instructions in order to enjoy not only the classic Greek coffee but also the making of it! This is the definition of your home away from home where you will get to relax and make your plans on what to do in Thessaloniki while having a bit of the city’s culture in your apartment. Whether you are visiting for work, studies or just holidays, Thess Residences is the only choice for fully serviced apartments in Thessaloniki that resemble more a proper house or block of flats than short or long term rentals.

host_about: My name is Dimitris. I am Civil Engineer and I have personally taken care of the design, renovation, maintenance and decoration of the apartments. We initially made great effort to show up the beauties of the building and the great location and then, add fruitful design features (wall papers, contemporary paintings, modern decorative features and objects and totally new modern and practicable furniture) to make living in the apartments a genuine, unique and pleasant experience. My interest is also to observe and explore the habits of the people and the way of living and aim to meet the desires and needs of their stay in my apartments. My guests get to experience the Greek hospitality in a more contemporary fashion. I have travelled a lot mainly in Europe and the Middle East and my goal for the future is to travel to distant and exotic destinations. My hobbies are dancing, watching movies, playing tennis and basketball, riding my bicycle, scuba diving and water sports. I love my city, Thessaloniki and my neighborhood. I will be more than glad to share with you all the secrets about where to eat, drink and have fun in Thessaloniki. host_about:
Thess Residences is a newly established complex of luxury yet affordable flats right in the heart of the city centre and in one of the “hottest” areas of Thessaloniki (or Saloniki as mostly called in Greece). Offering novel self-catering apartments serving as short or long term rentals in Thessaloniki, Thess Residences is your personal residence in Thessaloniki whatever your visiting schedule, from a few days until a few months; whether you are looking for vacation apartments for rent in Thessaloniki or you are travelling for business, Thess Residences offers a variety of luxury flats to serve all needs.
Built in 1951, the building was initially run by a Greek family that survived the 1922 disaster in Smyrni and served as a large factory that manufactured traditional pots, pans and “briki”. Briki is a kitchenware utensil used mostly to make the famous Greek coffee following a certain ritual. And as we could not but honour this legacy of the building, you will find a “briki” in your apartment kitchen along with coffee-making instructions in order to enjoy not only the classic Greek coffee but also the making of it! This is the definition of your home away from home where you will get to relax and make your plans on what to do in Thessaloniki while having a bit of the city’s culture in your apartment. Whether you are visiting for work, studies or just holidays, Thess Residences is the only choice for fully serviced apartments in Thessaloniki that resemble more a proper house or block of flats than short or long term rentals.

description:
Thess or Classic Residence is your private home in Thessaloniki. Covering almost 60 sq. meters, offers you and your company the luxury of doing whatever you like.
Separate bedroom area, a modern living area with space for a large sofa bed plus two extra roll-out beds.
Fully equipped kitchen and a dining area, bathrooms with walk in shower and all the classic Thess Residencies facilities like the flat smart T.V, electrical appliances and spacious cupboards.
host_about:
Thess Residences is a newly established complex of luxury yet affordable flats right in the heart of the city centre and in one of the “hottest” areas of Thessaloniki (or Saloniki as mostly called in Greece). Offering novel self-catering apartments serving as short or long term rentals in Thessaloniki, Thess Residences is your personal residence in Thessaloniki whatever your visiting schedule, from a few days until a few months; whether you are looking for vacation apartments for rent in Thessaloniki or you are travelling for business, Thess Residences offers a variety of luxury flats to serve all needs.
Built in 1951, the building was initially run by a Greek family that survived the 1922 disaster in Smyrni and served as a large factory that manufactured traditional pots, pans and “briki”. Briki is a kitchenware utensil used mostly to make the famous Greek coffee following a certain ritual. And as we could not but honour this legacy of the building, you will find a “briki” in your apartment kitchen along with coffee-making instructions in order to enjoy not only the classic Greek coffee but also the making of it! This is the definition of your home away from home where you will get to relax and make your plans on what to do in Thessaloniki while having a bit of the city’s culture in your apartment. Whether you are visiting for work, studies or just holidays, Thess Residences is the only choice for fully serviced apartments in Thessaloniki that resemble more a proper house or block of flats than short or long term rentals.

Just below the Andes, in a city where the clouds love to play with the unruly waves and people always carry a colorful smile with them. Then when i was ready to rediscover the place that I called my home,  memories from the past stirred on the surface and I was trying to find people, places, shops, corners again. 
In all this process of reinstalling myself to the city I came across with the opportunity to manage this hospitality project. host_about:
Thess Residences is a newly established complex of luxury yet affordable flats right in the heart of the city centre and in one of the “hottest” areas of Thessaloniki (or Saloniki as mostly called in Greece). Offering novel self-catering apartments serving as short or long term rentals in Thessaloniki, Thess Residences is your personal residence in Thessaloniki whatever your visiting schedule, from a few days until a few months; whether you are looking for vacation apartments for rent in Thessaloniki or you are travelling for business, Thess Residences offers a variety of luxury flats to serve all needs.
Built in 1951, the building was initially run by a Greek family that survived the 1922 disaster in Smyrni and served as a large factory that manufactured traditional pots, pans and “briki”. Briki is a kitchenware utensil used mostly to make the famous Greek coffee following a certain ritual. And as we could not but honour this legacy of the building, you will find a “briki” in your apartment kitchen along with coffee-making instructions in order to enjoy not only the classic Greek coffee but also the making of it! This is the definition of your home away from home where you will get to relax and make your plans on what to do in Thessaloniki while having a bit of the city’s culture in your apartment. Whether you are visiting for work, studies or just holidays, Thess Residences is the only choice for fully serviced apartments in Thessaloniki that resemble more a proper house or block of flats than short or long term rentals.

Hi everyone! I am very excited to join this global group of friends. There are many things that I can't live without but good friends are the most essential in my life.

I have traveled a lot but I can never say I've had enough of it.  I love the American South and the game parks of South Africa. They are definitely my two favorite parts in this world.  I don't follow a specific style when I travel, I  book the flight and a room and  of I go!!!  I am not very much of a book reader and I surely  love cooking. I can spend hours in the kitchen trying to prepare some Jambalaya or some crawfish  etouffee . When my energy is down at the end of day I like to hang out with friends at the neighborhood coffee shops or bars.  
As you can tell I do not like to rest that much, my motto in life, I guess would be "no rest for the weekend!!!"
